about: OpenWorks' notices to every copy of Shap and Shap Pocket (packages/shared/src/notice.ts, SUNSET.md). Plain words only. Each notice: id, level (info | update | warning | sunset), title, body, optional link (openworks.co.za or github.com), apps (["shap", "pocket"]), from / until (YYYY-MM-DD), belowVersion (only copies older than this), supportEndsOn (sunset).
